integrity: The classification exhausts all \(6435\) generator-column multiplicity vectors, tests the local-distance availability definition directly at every coordinate, quotients survivors by all \(168\) elements of \(\operatorname{GL}(3,2)\), and recomputes the spectral and automorphism invariants.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies linear size-eight extremizers for the binary \((r,\delta,a)=(2,2,2)\) case only. It does not classify nonlinear extremizers and does not assert uniqueness of repair-set choices.
title: Two linear extremizers for the first exact binary availability-two LRC case
